definitions.full: H2672. chatsab or chatseb [ חָצַב ] חָצֵב verb hew, hew out, cleave (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic חֲצַב ; SI 4. 6 participle plural החצבם ; compare Phoenician מחצב = Hebrew id. ) — Qal Perfect חָצֵב Isa 5:2 ; חָֽצְבָה Prov 9:1 ; חָצַבְתִּי Hosea 6:5 , etc.; Imperfect וַיַּחְצֹב 2Chr 26:10 ; 2 masculine singular תַּחְצֹב Deut 8:9 ; Infinitive construct לַחְצֹב Jer 2:13 ; לַחְצוֺב 1Chr 22:2 ; Participle active חֹצֵב Isa 10:15 4 t.; construct חֹצְבִי 22:16 ; חֹצְבִים 1Chr 22:2-3 t.; חֹצְבֵי 2Kin 12:13 ; passive חֲצוּבִים Deut 6:11 ; Neh 9:25 ; — 1 hew out, (dig) , wine-vat יֶקֶב Isa 5:2 ; sepulchre ( קֶבֶר ) 22:16 (twice in verse); cisterns בֹּרוֺת Deut 6:11 (twice in verse); 2Chr 26:10 ; Neh 9:25 , compare Jer 2:13 ; of mining תַּת ׳מהרריה נחשׁת Deut 8:9 out of its mountains thou mayst hew out copper . 2. a. hew stone 1Chr 22:2 ; metaphor of pillars Prov 9:1 (subject wisdom); elsewhere participle, hewer of stone 2Kin 12:13 ; 1Chr 22:2 , 15 (see SI 4.6above ); probably 1 Kings 5:29; 2Chr 2:1 ; 2:17 ( בָּהָר׳ח see Be), compare 24:12 ; Ezra 3:7 . b. apparently hew wood Isa 10:15 ׳ח בוֺ (i.e. בְּגַרְזֶן ). 3 metaph . hew in pieces Hosea 6:5 figurative of ׳י attacking people by agency of prophets (|| הֲרַגְתִּים ); divide, cleave subject ׳י s voice Psa 29:7 object אשׁ להבות , i.e. the thunder of his voice sends forked lightnings (but on text compare Che and critical note) Niph`al Imperfect יֵחָצְבוּן be cut, hewn, graven (words on rock) Job 19:24 . Pu`al Perfect חֻצַּבְתֶּם Isa 51:1 figurative, hewn out of rock (of Israel's origin; || נֻקַּר ). Hiph`il Participle מַחֲצֶ֫בֶת Isa 51:9 hew in pieces = Qal 3 , figurative of destroying רהב = Egypt (compare Psa 89:11 ).
